title: Themes
intro: The look of a quiz on the projection and the players' phones, from the lobby to the podium. Every host may use every theme; its owner and the administrators change it.
accessibleHint: Contrasts and marks checked for every player

cannotDelete.default: It is the instance's default theme: choose another default first.
cannotDelete.used_one: Used by {{count}} quiz: give it another theme first.
cannotDelete.used_other: Used by {{count}} quizzes: give them another theme first.

noMatch: No theme made by a host matches.
noneYet: No host has made a theme yet: start one from a shipped theme.
deleteText: “{{name}}” is used by no quiz. Its icons, font and effects go with it, unless something else holds them.
name: Name
startsFromHint: A theme stores only what it changes; the rest follows the shipped theme it starts from, and it falls back to it where it cannot be used.

check.slot_text_contrast: The white text on the answers reaches 4.5:1
check.text_background_contrast: The question's text reaches 4.5:1 on the background
check.slot_background_contrast: The answers stand out from the background (3:1)
check.accent_background_contrast: The accent stands out from the background (3:1)
check.slots_distinct: The eight answer colours look different
check.slots_distinct_color_vision: The first four stay apart for colour-blind players

preview.title: Capitals of the world
preview.prompt: What is the capital of Türkiye?

icons.title: Icon of the answer
icons.setHint: Given to the eight answers at once, each icon to its colour; any can still be changed one by one.
icons.uploadHint: A square, single-colour SVG: its fill takes the answers' text colour; strokes are dropped. Icons: Phosphor (MIT).
icons.strokeRemoved: The icon drew with strokes, which were dropped: it may look thinner than the file.

editor.from_one: From {{parent}} · used in {{count}} quiz — a change shows from its next game, never during one.
editor.from_other: From {{parent}} · used in {{count}} quizzes — a change shows from their next game, never during one.
editor.readOnly: {{owner}}'s theme: only its owner or an administrator changes it. Duplicate it to make your own.
editor.markersHint: Never the colour alone: each answer keeps a mark. Letters and numbers follow the answer's place in its question.
editor.textHint: Text and icons are white. The ratio after each answer is its text's contrast (4.5:1 for the badge).
editor.ratioHint: Contrast of the white text on this answer
editor.accentHint: The standings' bars, the “ready” and “you” marks.
editor.fontHint: An imported font says its licence: OFL 1.1, CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA.
editor.soundsHint: An effect the host picked for the lobby still wins; the lobby's mixer keeps the levels.
editor.confettiLabel: Confetti for the players who found the answer
editor.motionHint: The lobby's Animations switch and each device's reduced motion always win.
editor.accessibilityHint: Measured on the theme's colours, never declared. An accessible theme carries the badge in the library and the quiz settings; the others carry nothing. A projector shows colours its own way: these are guides, nothing is blocked.
editor.licenseHelp: The terms others may reuse the theme under; a community store needs one. You must hold the rights to its pictures, icons, effects and font.
